title: Pod Salt Core Peach Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pod Salt Core Peach Ice captures the juicy sweetness of sun-ripened Peach with a fresh Menthol twist. The smooth, velvety fruit flavour offers a gentle balance of full-bodied sweetness and subtle tang, lifted by a cool finish that keeps the profile clean and light on the tastebuds. Made with nicotine salts for a smoother inhale and faster nicotine delivery, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits including pod systems and refillable starter devices. Its 50VG/50PG blend supports rich flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 5mg, 11mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Pod Salt Core Nic Salts are produced in the UK and designed for vapers seeking consistency, quality and great-tasting flavours that are familiar yet wildly creative.
